title: CaPU v0.29 — Partial / Multi-Beat DMA Recovery Authority
scope: bounded reduced-width one-command ordered four-beat DMA transaction recovery authority layered on verified v0.28

workflow.name: CaPU vCML Multi-Beat DMA Recovery v0.29

verified_invariants: a committed beat cannot regain replay authority
an UNKNOWN beat requires discriminating evidence and has no replay authority
a later beat cannot issue across an unresolved earlier beat
exact NOT_COMMITTED evidence may reopen replay only for the exact beat after a committed prefix
retry consumes the beat's old negative evidence and creates a fresh UNKNOWN issue witness
exact committed evidence creates a durable per-beat completion receipt
stale partial checkpoints cannot override fresher exact per-beat evidence
transaction retirement requires all four beats COMMITTED and completion_receipt_bitmap == 1111
verification_note: The first candidate requested safety depth 22. The final authoritative head scopes bounded safety at depth 18 because the four-beat state/evidence product materially increased no-incremental SMT cost. RTL, testbench, canonical encoding and safety invariants were not weakened; cover remains depth 36 and all predecessor regressions were re-run on the final head.
claim_boundary: No production PCIe/CXL/NoC beat semantics, byte enables, cache-line tearing, burst splitting, device-memory ordering, IOMMU/cache/coherence, real persistence-domain atomicity, arbitrary burst length, out-of-order or overlapping fragments, multiple outstanding DMA transactions, queue ordering, completion interrupts, evidence authenticity/durability implementation, production widths, liveness/fairness, or unbounded correctness.
next_boundary: out-of-order / overlapping DMA fragment recovery authority
